scope: Bounded read-only review of the actual 4N6H EJ4 saved-frame audit helper; no dynamics, coordinate generation, or full trajectory reread performed.
method_review: Native and prepared residue identity includes chain, residue number, insertion code and residue name; actual selected atom names are unique and complete.
Full 58-atom SDF graph, element and charge inventory is matched to parameter identity; explicit bonded hydrogens are included.
RDKit rebuilds reference chirality tags from prepared 3D coordinates and confirms all four expected CCD carbon CIP descriptors.
Fixed-order four-neighbor scalar triple products preserve the relation to that validated reference; testing sign avoids dependence on center atom index or arbitrary global orientation.
Independent minimum-image vectors are appropriate for the asserted orthorhombic box and covalent-neighbor distances of this actual run; nonfinite or near-planar determinants fail.
Completed mode requires 101 saved samples at 0–100 ps; prefix mode is explicitly identified.
limits: This is a saved-frame tetrahedral-handedness check for four defined carbon centers, not proof of continuous-time stereochemical preservation, ligand pose accuracy, protonation correctness or dynamical convergence.
The helper is specialized to this known orthorhombic run and recorded parameter graph; it is not a generic arbitrary-ligand or triclinic-box validator.
No further scientific model acceptance follows from these checks.
